title: Executor Vulnerability Test Plus Plus
features:
Executor Vuln Test++

A comprehensive security testing tool for Roblox executors that evaluates common vulnerabilities and security bypass methods.
Overview

This tool tests Roblox executors for various security vulnerabilities and bypass methods, providing a detailed analysis of the executor's security posture.
Features

    Environment escape vulnerability testing
    LocalScript execution protection verification
    Metamethod hook bypass detection
    Security rating calculation
    Detailed vulnerability reporting

Usage

    Load the script into your executor
    Run the script
    Review the security analysis results
    Check individual test results for specific vulnerabilities

Test Results

The script provides:

    Overall security rating as a percentage
    Number of protected features
    Count of unmitigated vulnerabilities
    List of untested security aspects

Understanding Results

✅ - Protected/Secure ⛔ - Vulnerable/Insecure ⏺️ - Untested/Inconclusive
Contributing

Feel free to contribute by:

    Adding new security tests
    Improving existing detection methods
    Reporting false positives/negatives
    Suggesting security improvements
